review: Pinky Labubu Ryoshu is a brand new ID in the Limbus company created to play in the most beloved archetype of RR players - killing your allies! This Identity has a plethora of mechanics to interact with, and it sacrifices your identities. So without further ado, let’s dive into the sea of text that is House of Spiders (HoS for the rest of the review), Ryoshu. This identity has a total of 8 unique statuses, which will be simplified to: - Entanglement - A stacking mechanic; its cap increases based on HoS allies on the field and back up, and by using the S3-2 skill. It is also being increased based on the number of HoS allies who have died. Every skill will deal bonus slash damage based on this stack, so the more HoS allies you have and kill, the more damage she will do. - String Severance - Unique buff that bluntly decreases damage taken by HoS Ryoshu.
